cnt=np.zeros((N,4,37), dtype=np.int32)
t=time.time()
chunk=2000
for start in range(0,N,chunk):
    end=min(N,start+chunk)
    rarr=np.frombuffer(''.join(reads[start:end]).encode(),dtype=np.uint8).reshape(end-start,36)
    # compare all reads chunk to all windows; memory
    d1=np.count_nonzero(ref[None,:,:]"'!=rarr[:,None,:],axis=2) # (nchunk, nwin)
    d2=np.count_nonzero(ref_rc[None,:,:]!=rarr[:,None,:],axis=2)
    for j in range(end-start):
        # for each chr, concatenate distances from d1 and d2 for windows of that chr
        for ci in range(4):
